limitations: Three transferring callers are covered, selected from sourced role histories before this expanded fit. This is not league-wide coverage; unmapped stints remain unknown.
Official reports establish the primary role, not a snap-by-snap audit. Shared decisions and unreported temporary delegation may remain.
Published retrospective role confirmation does not reveal play outcomes to the model; nevertheless this is reconstructed historical metadata, not a database archived before each kickoff.
The 2026 caller change is source-backed context and a boundary test only. No 2026 outcomes enter training or evaluation.
Moore’s Dallas head-coach change and Chargers interim head-coach change do not by themselves end his caller tenure. Quarterback and roster changes are not causal controls.
Intervals concern sampled games; three callers cannot establish generalization to all coaches.
Named-passers summaries are not causal adjustment or verified starting-QB labels.
Retrospective finalized data and previously studied seasons do not establish prospective live performance.
